text:
```python
import pandas as pd

def etl_incremental(records, measures, last_watermark=None):
    df = pd.DataFrame(records)
    df['data'] = pd.to_datetime(df['data'], errors='coerce')
    df['data'] = df['data'].fillna(pd.Timestamp('1970-01-01'))
    
    if last_watermark:
        df = df[df['data'] > pd.to_datetime(last_watermark)]
    
    df['misura'] = measures[:len(df)]
    return df.set_index('id')
